audience: marketing and product teams that make licensed images with Bria

useCases.title: Generate an image from a prompt
useCases.text: Start an image job from a text prompt, then check its status until the result holds the image link.

useCases.title: Remove the background of an image
useCases.text: Start a background removal for a public image link or a base64 image, then read the transparent image link when it completes.

useCases.title: Check a job that is still running
useCases.text: Read the progress of an earlier Bria job by its request id, and get the image link when it completes.
